Are you a great salesperson wanting to make a difference? Do you want to join an exciting, young company that has carved out a unique market niche in the fast growing solar industry?

Profile - Bachelor's degree; - Fluent in Dutch and English, verbal and written; - At least 4 years of sales/account management experience, preferably technical in nature; - Previous roofing and/or solar industry sales experience; - Pro-active plus strong attention to details; - Great people skills and customer service; - Able and willing to travel.
